key.name: appearance
key.description: Whether the whole application follows the system, or is always light or always dark.

key.name: editor-theme
key.description: Colour theme family of the editor and preview; each has a light and a dark variant.

key.name: code-font
key.description: Font family of the editor. Empty means the system monospace font.

key.name: preview-font
key.description: Font family of the preview. Empty means the system interface font.

key.name: code-font-size
key.description: Editor font size in points. 0 means the system default size.

key.name: preview-font-size
key.description: Preview font size in points. 0 means the system default size.

key.name: wrap-text
key.description: Wrap long lines in the editor.

key.name: wrap-column
key.description: Wrap after this many characters, or at the window edge if that comes first.

key.name: preview-width
key.description: Maximum width of the preview text as a percentage of the window width.

key.name: show-minimap
key.description: Show the code map beside the editor.

key.name: show-status-bar
key.description: Show path, counts, encoding and line ending.

key.name: watch-files
key.description: Reload when the file changes on disk.

key.name: convert-encoding
key.description: Save as UTF-8 instead of the file's own encoding.

key.name: convert-line-endings
key.description: Save with LF instead of the file's own line endings.

key.name: view-mode
key.description: Which panes are shown: 0 editor only, 1 preview only, 2 both.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window is maximized.
